official_source.value: http://www.handcorpus.org/datasets/HUSTdataset.zip (distribution page https://www.handcorpus.org/?p=1596); the retracted paper's own data-availability statement points to Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.gg8g5

exact_title_version.value: HUST Dataset (March 2016) - 'Joint angles of human hand while executing the grasping tasks of Feix taxonom.'

value.what_is_VERIFIED: the DOF COUNT, and nothing else
value.what_is_NOT: no joint-name list is published anywhere this audit could reach, so the 16 variables cannot be enumerated

value.classification: glove-derived by equipment class; whether a calibration transform was applied, and of what form, is UNKNOWN
value.why_unknown: the only description of the acquisition is in a RETRACTED article, and the dataset page itself publishes no method

value.verification: IMPOSSIBLE - no data was obtained, and the declaring page is not the authors' repository

hand_laterality.value: right hand only - 'subjects ... placed their right arm on the table'

value.independent_verification: NONE - the paper is retracted and the data is unobtainable

value.objects: three objects of different sizes/shapes per task type, chosen from common daily objects (cylinders, disks, spheres, cards)
value.repetitions: each test repeated three times per object
value.what_is_NOT_published: the mapping from each of the 33 task types to a file, segment or column

value.protocol: 'the subjects extended their right hand in a natural full extension. Upon hearing the go command, the subjects started to grasp the object at a self-paced speed' - so a reach-to-grasp transition exists in the recording

value.reason: the mapping matrix can assign no confidence without a channel list, a sign convention and a zero definition

value.handcorpus_url: HTTP 500 'The server can not find the requested resource' on every attempt
value.dryad: landing page HTTP 200; file_stream behind an Anubis proof-of-work interstitial (HTTP 403 to an automated GET)

license.note: no licence field was retrievable from the Dryad API record and the dataset page states none

value.publisher_statement: 'the PLOS ONE editors consider that the work cannot be relied upon and retract this publication'

tasking_instruction_honoured: the tasking asked to 'explicitly verify the previously assumed facts rather than trusting them'.  Two previously assumed facts did NOT survive: the dataset is not obtainable, and its associated publication is retracted
